official_stats.stat: The RBI Ombudsman received 13.34 lakh complaints against banks, NBFCs and payment companies in FY 2024-25, up 13.55% on the year before. This is sector-wide and earlier than this report's window; it gives no figure for Paytm or for payment apps alone.
official_stats.source: RBI Ombudsman Annual Report 2024-25, via ANI/The Tribune, 1 Dec 2025

official_stats.stat: Loans and advances were the largest category (29.25% of complaints); mobile and electronic banking complaints fell 12.74% year on year.
